verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment for filing integrations is a fair question for a government agency that runs online tax registration and wage-reporting services, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test mode, or non-production environment. The only programmatic channels are the production UTR/UTS applications and QuickFile, and the probes found no published API at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
